text: Nausharo Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Nausharo Type: Archaeological Site - Settlement Province: Balochistan District: Kachhi Period: Proto Historic Relative Chronology: 3500 BCE - 1800 BCE Description: The site is located in the Bolan plain in Bhag tehsil of Kacchi district. It consists of four cultural periods. It possessed dwelling structures, painted ceramics, figurines of human and animals. Harappan seals. It is a remarkable settlement with local Balochi tradition to the advent of Indus Civilization (Franke and Cortesi 2015:343). The pottery represented Pirak-III, early to mature Harappan and Kot Diji, Kulli, Amri-Nal and Kechi Beg, while pottery of historic period was also documented.
